display.title: Amazon SQS message-queue API
display.summary: The complete 23-action Amazon Simple Queue Service API, preserving AWS JSON 1.0, AWS Query compatibility, SigV4, and regional endpoint rules. The web Playground does not yet have an AWS SigV4 and region-selection execution adapter; use the local SDK/CLI to call SQS.

documentation.stabilityNote: The contract is from the fixed Smithy 2.0 service model in AWS SDK for JavaScript v3. SQS is a stateful messaging system: receiving changes message visibility, and write, delete, purge, permission, tagging, and message-move actions can affect production queues. The web Playground lacks an AWS SigV4, region, and endpoint-rules adapter, so it cannot send SQS requests. This is an adapter limitation, not an Endpoint disablement policy.

pricing.summary: Amazon SQS pricing is based on AWS dimensions such as requests and data transfer. Free-tier eligibility, regional prices, FIFO/high-throughput costs, and related AWS service charges are determined by the official pricing page and the caller account.

credentials.description: Use the AWS default credential provider chain. Common environment variables are AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, optional AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, and AWS_REGION. Credentials remain in the caller environment and must never appear in examples, logs, or Hub.
